scripts.build: node scripts/bump-version.js && vite build && cp -r public/js/. dist/js/ && echo '{"version":1,"include":["/*"],"exclude":["/js/*"]}' > dist/_routes.json
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name groundwork-crm
scripts.test: vitest run && npm run test:browser-js && npm run test:sales-process-static
scripts.//test:browser-js: Plain browser scripts under public/js. Separate from vitest because that suite runs in the Cloudflare workers pool, and workerd is pinned to UTC — it ignores TZ, so the date bugs these cover are invisible there. Chained onto `test` so CI still gates on them.
scripts.test:browser-js: TZ=America/New_York node --test tests/gw-date.test.mjs tests/invoice-dates.test.mjs tests/injection-contexts.test.mjs tests/date-render-escaping.test.mjs tests/invoice-bulk-actions.test.mjs tests/payments-page.test.mjs tests/stripe-charge-columns.test.mjs tests/invoice-route-gates.test.mjs tests/pipeline-totals.test.mjs tests/no-shadow-assets.test.mjs tests/backfill-cli-args.test.mjs tests/e2e-fixture-hygiene.test.mjs tests/test-runner-integrity.test.mjs tests/deploy-workflow-gate.test.mjs tests/mobile-nav-tabs.test.mjs tests/finance-nav-labels.test.mjs
scripts.//test:sales-process-static: Source-level guarantees for the sales-process feature: the migration is additive, the shared resolver is rename-invariant, and the runtime never reads platform leads across tenants. Pure text and vm checks, no build and no database, so they are chained onto `test` alongside test:browser-js rather than kept behind their own command like the integration suites above.
